chunks.text: 4.2.1 Relevant Legislation Trade Marks Regulations 1995 Part 17A.2 Definitions - Record of International Registrations Part 17A.66 Record of International Registrations 4.2.2 General Description Details of IRDAs and protected international trade marks are held on the Record of International Registrations. It is part of the current Trade Marks Office database. It includes the same information that is available on national applications and registrations. The following information is also included: the international registration number the date IP Australia was notified of the IRDA the date the international registration is due for renewal
